title: Marriages and the first family
summary: Hall's first wife, second wife and three children.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: (Recording interruption,)
We were talking before about again
the way someone lives affects the way they play, and you've had -- you've been a family man during your career in music, and I'd like you to talk a little bit about that.
Well, --
You were unattached by the time you got to New York, or did it --
I married shortly after I got to New York. And the person who I thought was a glamour girl.
Uh-huh. How did you meet her?
We went to school together. And that's -- that started me in my cabaret-night club playing career.
Why, what was her profession?
She was just a --
Oh, when you said glamour girl, I thought you meant to say a dancer or entertainer or something.
No, no. No, but she knew everybody in show business when they used to come to the theaters in Philly, you know, and by the same token I got a chance to meet them.

Then that lasted a few years, And I guess I outgrew her or she outgrew me, one or the other; but meanwhile I'm doing different things musically, and I got married again and had three kids, Barbara, Alfred and Nancy.
What was your first wife's name?
(Inaudible).
No, I'd like to forget her.
Cancel that.
(Laughter.)
Well, during that time did she assume a housewife's role and raise the children, or did she work also?
My first wife?
No, your second wife.
My second wife, no, she didn't work while I was -- while I was there,
Right. She had three children,
Yeah.
What were their -- names?
